name: Marrow Jack
summary: Kill the reaver captain in his redoubt and bring back his seal.
startText: Their captain is a man called Marrow Jack. He sits in the redoubt on the east side of the Hollow. Bring me his seal.
inProgressText: Marrow Jack still holds the redoubt. Bring me his seal.
completionText: Then the quarry is open. This ring was meant for the next Marshal. You have earned it more.
